distribution_contract.selection_owner: Main chooses primary geometry and normalized/security parameters; manifest fixed controls do not promote anything.
distribution_contract.warmup: Two discarded independent processes per config/mode warm machine/filesystem caches, not reused in-process prover state. Fresh OS entropy per measured proof.
distribution_contract.coverage: Default three configs: 180 measured proofs plus 12 excluded distinct warmups. C0 can join same alternating schedule.
distribution_contract.C0_command_template: Use {input} and {output}, or {statement}/{witness}/{case_index}/{output}; C0 need not accept fake case-index flag.
distribution_contract.artifact_contract: Each command creates fresh output: result_file(default results.json) has native_verified=true, prove_ms, verify_ms, raw_proof_bytes, peak_rss_bytes; proof_file(default proof.postcard); configuration_file(default configuration.json) byte-stable within config. All filenames overrideable. source_files lists source/binary/lock paths.
distribution_contract.C0_owner: Main owns same-codec C0 exporter and result adapter; no C0 or models edits by worker.
distribution_contract.normalized_execution: Main writes fresh resume-* manifest with selected geometry/normalized values/security_model ID, then executes with fresh output. Fixed controls must not be relabeled normalized.
